Suresh Ji · Jaipur · Coordinated main model

Walnut, stone & quiet colour

FIRST FLOOR · OP–1 · MAIN FILE
10 ft ceiling · Updated 27 Oct 2026

Warm chalk walls, walnut laminate, stone-look tile, terracotta and dusty blue accents, with brushed steel fittings.

Living TV backing clears W5 and rises to the ceiling; the 75 in screen is mounted 1 ft higher. The AC is centred on the solid left wall, entry controls sit below W5, and the sofa has an illuminated walnut service plank with switches and charging.

The puja cabinet has working pocket-fold doors and a full-width pull-out diya tray. Pulling out the tray automatically opens the shrine; closing the shrine retracts the tray first.

R-011 (15 Oct 2026) follows the revised architect layout: Bedroom 2 study unit with the AC on the south wall, lobby shoe rack, rear-shaft kota shelf and the Bedroom 3 east-wall run.

Master bathroom (R-012 to R-016, 27 Oct 2026): open shower with no glass, a flush linear drain on the back wall under the mixer, a floating vanity, a 25 L vertical geyser and a raised washer in the niche. Floor tile joints are 1 mm throughout.

All traced windows, walls, columns and ventilation shafts are retained. Joinery and appliance sizes require site measurement before fabrication.
